task_title: board_shrink_check compares row COUNT only: same-count wholesale replacement passes undetected
task_criteria: AC1: checker compares row identity so a same-count wholesale replacement on a scratch clone is refused exit 1 naming changed ids. AC2: legit in-place single-row edits still pass exit 0. AC3: existing AUG-194 tests stay green; new tests cover the same-count-replacement refusal.

items.criterion: AC1: checker compares row identity so a same-count wholesale replacement on a scratch clone is refused exit 1 naming changed ids. AC2: legit in-place single-row edits still pass exit 0. AC3: existing AUG-194 tests stay green; new tests cover the same-count-replacement refusal.
items.detail: AC1: scripts/board_shrink_check.py:158 computes lost=sorted(old[1]-new[1]) and :166 refuses on `new[0] < old[0] or lost` with ids named at :191-196. Fresh run `/home/kara/auger/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_board_shrink_check.py -p no:cacheprovider -q` -> exit_code=0, '29 passed in 3.07s'. Independent scratch-clone replay with the real installed hook (tmp repo, installer-run hook): replacement commit printed 'board-shrink: REFUSED baseline=3 candidate=3 lost ids=A, B, C', exit=1, HEAD unchanged. AC2: same scratch replay, in-place edit of row B -> 'board-shrink: OK baseline=3 candidate=3 lost ids=(none)', exit 0, commit landed with {"id":"B","status":"complete"}; test_single_row_in_place_edit_passes, reorder and append arms green in the fresh run. AC3: 29 passed (AUG-194 baseline was 19; before/after diff shows the only removed test is the old blind-spot arm asserting 'SAME-COUNT wholesale replacement is NOT detected', flipped into test_same_count_replacement_is_refused_naming_missing_ids); new tests cover equal-count refusal, growing-count refusal, --recent mode refusal, and loud override. Full gate battery (bash tests/gate.sh) needs a live DuckBrain URL and was namespace-lock blocked on this host (409 disclosed in commit 4de11c4 message); the checker's own suite, mutation arm, and ruff ('All checks passed!') are green.

items.criterion: derived: the refusal is actually reachable on the commit path — hook exit code propagates (commit does not land) and CI grades landed commits in --recent mode
items.detail: install_board_guard.py:38-44 installs `python3 "<checker>" || exit 1` gated on staged board paths; proven live in the scratch clone: board replacement commit exit=1 with HEAD unchanged, while an unrelated commit passed without invoking the check. CI wiring: .github/workflows/ci.yml:71 runs `python3 scripts/board_shrink_check.py --recent` before the gate step (ci.yml:152), and workflow_findings tests pin --recent mode, step order, and fetch-depth.

items.criterion: derived: no AUG-194 coverage was lost — every surviving pre-change arm still exists and passes, ruff clean
